title: hud.element 1.0
description: ui::HudElement: an addon's elements in one of the game's HUD dials. The build composes every enabled addon's records for a dial into one grown dial scene, its dial template groups and the editor preview. Sprites are PNG files, positions are HUD units (1 unit = 1 px of a 640x360 frame, origin at the dial centre, v down).

dial.description: The car class dial the elements live in: f1_26 (the 2026 dial), f1_25 (the 2025 dial) or f2. The spectator HUD's dial of the same class runs the same elements.

scene.description: Advanced target, in place of dial: the eaid:// path of a stock scene (.idf) the elements grow. Takes text and group elements only. Needs parent_ui and no dial.

parent_ui.description: With scene: the dotted path in the HUD template of the node that instances the scene (the root name first), such as hud_mfd_dynamic.mfd.attacher.car_damage_panel. The bound nodes go straight under it, named <prefix>_<name>.

spectator.description: False leaves the spectator HUD's dial of this class without the elements.

stock.description: What happens to the stock dial's parts: keep leaves them, hide has the dial template hide them, park moves them off screen. Absent: park in f1_26, hide in the other dials.

stock_parts.description: The stock parts keep, hide and park act on. Absent: frame, fuel, holder_central and pit_indicator.

box.description: The customisation footprint in HUD units, [x0, y0, x1, y1]. Absent: the bounds of the sprite named base, or of every sprite.

prefix.description: The start of every element and template node name the record adds. Absent: the addon id and the record key, lowercase, with _ between words.

variants.description: Other dials the same art serves, as patches on this record, by name.

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.

png.description: A PNG in the addon, straight alpha. The core bleeds the edge colour into the transparent pixels and encodes sRGB BC7. Its width and height are multiples of 4.

bounds.description: Where the sprite sits, [x0, y0, x1, y1] in HUD units. Absent: centred on the origin at ppu pixels per unit.

tint.description: A colour that multiplies the pixels (the editor preview uses it for team-coloured white art).

bind.description: A value the template binds. Exactly one of view_model, game, session and session_car. view_model is one of the addon's leaves (view_model_data.<name>, or ui_menu_data.<name> where a record targets a scene); game is a name in the core's table of the dial's own values; session is a #session path; session_car reads a car of the session by vehicle id.

decision.description: A decision node of the dial template. svcd compares one game value with equals and shows the elements in yes (the others in no); mvcd shows, for each state of a game value, the elements listed for that state.

preview.description: What the HUD editor shows: leaf, game value and session path names as keys, and the value each reads in the preview.
